answers.value: A single case with identified anti-selection risk; scope = deciding the policy structure (amount limit, benefit design, exclusion/rider, ownership condition) that mitigates the anti-selection risk for one case (CASE-####).
The current underwriting cycle for the case; the structure decision precedes the final offer and reflects the risk factors documented at that point.

The identified anti-selection risk, the candidate structures considered and the chosen structure with its rationale are all populated; a chosen structure with no linked risk driver is treated as incomplete.

Each identified anti-selection risk maps to at least one mitigating structural control in the decision (coverage of drivers reconciles: risks addressed = risks identified); unaddressed drivers are flagged.
The structure decision and rationale are saved to OpenText /UW/<case-no>/financial/ with timestamp and version and linked to the offer terms; retained 7 years.

Where the applicant declines a required structural condition, the case is logged as an exception in the underwriting workstation with disposition (revise terms / refer to Senior Underwriter / decline) and reason.
Structure options follow the current financial-underwriting guideline for anti-selection controls; the guideline version is cited in the decision note.
The chosen structure is tested against a worse-case scenario for the identified risk; if the control does not hold under stress, a stronger structure is selected.
Materiality threshold = any residual anti-selection exposure above the retention/appetite limit requires escalation before the structure is finalised.
Each structural control traces to its risk driver and to the source screen/document (application, financials, MIB result) that evidenced the risk in the case file.
The case status advances to 'Structured / Ready to Offer' only once every identified risk driver has a linked mitigating control recorded.
Decision date and the effective date of the structural conditions are recorded and consistent with the case timeline and offer validity window.
25 cases per quarter flagged with anti-selection risk, sampled across products, whose structure decision and rationale are inspected.
PASS = every identified anti-selection driver has a documented mitigating structural control and a rationale for 100% of sampled cases; FAIL = any flagged risk left without a structural control.
Cases with unaddressed drivers are returned for restructure or referred to a Senior Underwriter within 5 business days before any offer is issued.
Acceptance = the chosen structure demonstrably mitigates each identified anti-selection risk and its rationale is documented and linked to the offer.
Evidence stored in OpenText /UW/<case-no>/financial/ (structure decision + rationale), cross-linked from the PolicyCenter offer terms and underwriting workstation.

Source-system field definitions from the underwriting case data dictionary (risk_driver, control_type, amount_limit, rider/exclusion_code, rationale); control total = count of identified risk drivers, which must equal the count of linked mitigating controls (0 unaddressed).

answers.value: A single case's decision record; scope = documenting the financial-underwriting rationale and the sources relied upon for one case (CASE-####) in the underwriting case record.
The current underwriting cycle for the case; the rationale is recorded at the decision point, referencing evidence dated within the case timeline.

The rationale states the financial need/justification, the amount decision, the anti-selection assessment and every source relied upon (income docs, net-worth statements, MIB, coverage aggregation); a decision with no stated basis is incomplete.
Each source cited in the rationale exists in the case file and each material figure (income, net worth, aggregate coverage, maximum amount) reconciles to its source document (delta = 0).
The rationale narrative is stored in OpenText /UW/<case-no>/financial/ with timestamp and version and linked to the final decision; retained 7 years for market-conduct review.

If a cited source is missing or inconsistent, an exception is logged in the underwriting workstation with disposition (obtain document / correct figure / re-review) and reason before the decision is finalised.
The rationale references the financial-underwriting guideline version applied to the amount and structure decisions.
Where the decision hinged on a judgement call (e.g. estimated income), the rationale documents the range considered and why the chosen figure is reasonable.
Materiality threshold = any figure driving the amount decision by more than 10% must have its source explicitly cited and reconciled in the rationale.
25 financially-underwritten cases per quarter, sampled across amount tiers, whose rationale record is inspected for completeness and source support.
PASS = a rationale stating the basis and citing sources that reconcile is present for 100% of sampled cases; FAIL = any decision lacking a rationale or citing an unsupported/unreconciled figure.
Files failing inspection are returned to the Underwriter to complete the rationale or attach missing sources within 5 business days; repeat gaps escalate to a Senior Underwriter for quality review.
Field definitions from the underwriting case data dictionary: financial_justification, amount_decision, anti_selection_assessment, sources_relied_upon, guideline_version.
Control total = each material figure in the rationale (income, net worth, aggregate coverage, maximum amount) reconciles to its cited source document to the dollar.

Approved methodology = the financial-underwriting guideline version applied to the amount/structure decisions; parameter source = the verified financial evidence and data sources (income documents, net-worth statements, MIB/coverage aggregation) cited in the rationale and held in the case file.
